security_problem: Without a DPoP nonce, an intercepted visor-gateway proof can race the first jti consume, or be replayed if -dpop-replay is lost before iat+ClockSkew. A first request without a nonce must not burn that jti.
required_behavior: visor-gateway requires a server-issued nonce claim on resource DPoP proofs. Missing or unknown nonce is HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate error=use_dpop_nonce and a DPoP-Nonce header. Nonces are unguessable, single-use, and process-local (restart forgets them). The nonce is checked before proof-jti consume. visor-session and the A2A tripper retry once on that challenge. STS POST /oauth/token does not require a nonce. This is not Production.
failure_behavior: Fail closed: unknown nonce, consumed nonce, and missing nonce are 401 with no backend forward. A captured proof cannot be replayed after process restart from a lost -dpop-replay log.
